Information For - Postgraduate Research Students
Postgraduate research students
Postgraduate study at ANU gets you closer to your calling.
Enquire
now
Your community of discovery
Higher degree by research students at The Australian National University (ANU) are part of a
supportive discovery community. Uncover your opportunity to make a substantial and original contribution to your
discipline or area of professional practice in our ultramodern facilities.
Study options
Explore our Master of Philosophy (MPhil) or Doctor of Philosophy
degrees (PhD) and prepare to join our collaborative research community.
College contacts
Find a supervisor, gain their college's endorsement before applying
and discover if you need to follow a unique application process.
How to apply
Once you have drafted a research proposal and found a potential
supervisor, applying to ANU is easy. And it’s free.
Campus
tours
Get a taste of the ANU experience by booking a campus tour with one
of our student ambassadors.
Scholarships
Push the frontiers of knowledge with a research scholarship. We have
one for every situation and automatically consider you for some when you apply.
Accommodation guarantee
We guarantee all first-year students a room in a university
residence. Browse the options and choose where you’d like to live.
Student life
One of the best things about studying at ANU is the campus
experience. Discover all the things you can get involved in.
Fees & payments
Everything you need to know about tuition and other university
expenses, and how to pay for them.
Research training
Explore our range of workshops, events and short courses. They
enhance research and professional development.
Support services
Our support services help students transition to life at ANU and
thrive before and after graduation.
Accepting your offer
Congratulations! Find out how to accept your offer from ANU and start
picturing yourself studying here.
Meet Carys Chan
Meet award-winning student Carys Chan. She has recently begun a PhD that examines what work-life balance means to Singaporean workers.
